description: Use competitor changes and gaps as triggers and evidence for your own priority list; never as a second audit target or a rank tracker. Set view: brief (30-day brief per competitor: new pages, coverage, themes, gaps, pace), changes (competitor sitemap events: added, removed, lastmod; days/type), feed (one competitor's detected pages with content-match tier, own-page matches and triage state; match/triage), gaps (competitor pages with no matching own page, worst first), rank (latest keyword-compare top-10 standings), discovery (candidate competitors from the top 10 of your tracked keywords). Competitor sites are read-only and are addressed by their own siteId (role=competitor); every write tool rejects them. For gaps as ranked opportunities use get_opportunities.
